**Daily Devotional**

**April 2**

*7 And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power. (Acts 1:7 KJV)*

This is where the disciples had just asked Jesus when He would restore the kingdom to Israel. Most people in the Old Testament days did not have understanding that the Messiah would come to earth twice, so they were thinking that Jesus was going to return the kingdom to Israel on this first appearance on earth. Jesus made it clear that no one knows when His second coming will occur, but only Father God (Mark 13:32).

This verse is after Jesus was resurrected and just before His ascension into Heaven. He then told the disciples to await the coming of the Holy Spirit to give them power (Acts 1:4-5), so that they could then go and preach the Gospel to the world (Acts 1:8). It is foolish for us to try and determine the exact time of Jesus return, as it is not meant for us to know. It will happen when God tells Jesus to come get His children (Revelation 14:14-16), and not before. Many people try to predict the exact time of Jesus return, and it is totally wasted time. Do not fall for those that predict things that the bible says we can not know, as the Word of God is truth (John 17:17), and always correct.
